criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Four frames clear the stage test: 6 the best (four ember-lined pads in one pool, a worker inside the near line), 7 (stubs counted 10 and 13), 1 and 2. Four lean on a default: 5 a grey grating reading as a floor vent with a flat brown open stretch; 3 a square-on pack still reading as a slatted crate, cropped, beside a mannequin; 4 a frontal copper bar chart over dead black; 8 a mannequin, a block of paper, a mid-tone horizon band and a girt through a dek line. Type sits over columns on 1 and 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world, casts right, the ember motif evolving, a real camera move, value dark across the filmstrip; frames 3 and 4 sit in a black void outside the world and the ember on 5 reads brown.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to verbatim primary ERCOT quotes; the drawn scales measure honest. The one loose join: 'highest N/A rate' rests on a rate reading derived from table rows the fact check refused to quote; defensible and disclosed.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, when, where and next are named; the stake stays general; the December 17th meeting is left out; slide 8 a separate process.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover states the finding and 6 is a real turn; 2 and 3 run subset before whole; 8 cuttable; the close a date.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, on register, a good cover line and a sharp caption question; four deks end on 'drawn to illustrate'; little regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: lastLight again; empty pads, a copper bus bar relief and a fence close all recent; no. 60 was the same RFI at issue; the reel yard is fresh.

one_sentence_fix: Build the measured frames 3, 4 and 5 inside the staged site: a three-quarter uncropped raked copper pack with the seam behind, the four packs at an angle with casts across lit caliche, the trench in perspective in the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A grey grating on mottled grey reads as a floor vent; the open stretch a flat brown panel; no true black, no bright edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the open stretch three times deeper with ember walls under a low rake, or reshoot it in perspective at a 1.5 m eye in the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A square-on pack reads as a slat crate, cropped so the count is never whole; the worker a mannequin.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter view pulled back to show the whole end face and length, raked from the low left key; the worker a rim-lit silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin, one block of paper, a mid-tone horizon band and a girt through a dek line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera so the girt drops below the dek, light the figure only from the work light, crop to table, paper and lamp pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A frontal orthographic copper bar chart with no seam and a dead black bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rotate the row about 20 degrees, drop the eye, let the casts run across lit caliche, bring the seam in.
